cues.en: Mike: Now I'm going to illustrate to you implementing ICA in code.
cues.zh: Mike：現在示範 ICA 程式實作。

cues.en: I don't typically recommend this, but I do recommend for this one video that the Python viewers out there, the Python participants also watch the MATLAB code.
cues.zh: 通常不這樣建議，但這支希望 Python 學員也看 MATLAB 程式。

cues.en: And that's because the MATLAB implementation of ICA that I'm using, which is the JADE algorithm, does a really great job of separating the two independent sources in this
cues.zh: 因為使用的 MATLAB JADE 演算法，很擅長分離這份

cues.en: small sample dataset that I've created.
cues.zh: 小型資料集的兩個獨立來源。

cues.en: But in Python, I use the scikit-learn implementation of FAST ICA and it actually doesn't do a very good job.
cues.zh: Python 用 scikit-learn FastICA，效果卻不太好。

cues.en: That's also a bit consistent with my personal experience with ICA that sometimes it seems to work and sometimes it doesn't really converge onto a good solution.
cues.zh: 與個人經驗有點一致，有時有效，有時無法收斂到好解。

cues.en: And it's a little bit opaque why that happens because of the way that ICA is, it tends to be stochastic in the way that it tends to be implemented.
cues.zh: 原因有點不透明，因為 ICA 實作通常帶隨機性。

cues.en: Anyway, let's begin.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Here, I create the data.
cues.zh: 建立資料。

cues.en: I'm starting to create two non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 兩個非高斯分布。

cues.en: So one is just a uniform distribution of random numbers, and this one is a uniform distribution, but then raised to the fourth power.
cues.zh: 一個均勻隨機數，另一個均勻分布後取四次方。

cues.en: So that's gonna give us this almost power law distribution of numbers where we have a high concentration of data points with small values close to zero, and then the data values
cues.zh: 像冪律分布，很多點數值小、靠近 0，數值愈大，

cues.en: get increasingly unlikely as they get larger.
cues.zh: 出現機率愈低。

cues.en: Okay, so then we can plot them here.
cues.zh: 畫圖。

cues.en: So here you see the uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 這是均勻分布。

cues.en: This is like the, I don't think we can really call this a power law distribution, but it's this other distribution raised to the fourth power.
cues.zh: 這個不太能真正叫冪律，但就是另一分布取四次方。

cues.en: Here, you see the distributions of the two datasets combined.
cues.zh: 這是兩資料集結合後的分布。

cues.en: Now, this is not exactly a Gaussian as you might expect for the central limit theorem, but, you know, it's certainly more Gaussian
cues.zh: 不像中央極限定理預期的精確高斯，但肯定比

cues.en: than either one of these distributions in and of themselves.
cues.zh: 兩個單獨分布更像高斯。

cues.en: I'm also using this optional stairs DisplayStyle of the histogram function, which I normally don't like this.
cues.zh: 也用 histogram 的 stairs DisplayStyle 選項，通常我不喜歡。

cues.en: I normally don't think it looks very good, but I wanted to have it in here anyway just to show you some of the other options for stylizing your histograms.
cues.zh: 覺得不太好看，但想展示其他直方圖樣式。

cues.en: Okay, but, so this is just a reminder of how ICA is approaching these signals.
cues.zh: 提醒 ICA 如何看這些訊號。

cues.en: So ICA is going to see this distribution and it's gonna say, well, this looks too much like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 看到這個就會說，太像高斯。

cues.en: So how can I separate out these different signals to see if I can create the sum of non-Gaussian sources?
cues.zh: 如何分離不同訊號，得到非高斯來源相加？

cues.en: And they might look something like this.
cues.zh: 可能像這樣。

cues.en: Okay, so that's what we do here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是如此。

cues.en: I'm creating another dataset that is a linear combination of these two signals.
cues.zh: 建立另一資料集，是兩訊號線性組合。

cues.en: So I'm taking, I call it dist1, but this is the first dataset and the second dataset.
cues.zh: 稱為 dist1，也就是第一與第二資料集。

cues.en: So you can see that I'm linearly mixing them together.
cues.zh: 線性混合。

cues.en: So it's 40% of dataset one and 30% of dataset two, they get combined into the first data channel.
cues.zh: 第一資料通道是資料一的 40%，加資料二的 30%。

cues.en: And the second data channel is 80% of distribution one and minus 70% of distribution two.
cues.zh: 第二通道是資料一的 80%，減資料二的 70%。

cues.en: So this is our dataset here.
cues.zh: 這是資料。

cues.en: It's two by 1,000 for two data channels and 1,000 observations, so two features.
cues.zh: 2 乘 1,000，兩通道、1,000 筆觀察，也就是兩特徵。

cues.en: And those features are mixed between our two original source vectors.
cues.zh: 特徵混合了兩個原始來源向量。

cues.en: So then we wanna see whether the JADE algorithm, which is just an ICA algorithm, can reconstruct these two distributions based on their linear mixture here.
cues.zh: 看 JADE 這個 ICA 演算法，能否從線性混合重建兩分布。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see.
cues.zh: 來看看。

cues.en: I think I'll just run all the rest of this.
cues.zh: 直接執行剩餘全部。

cues.en: Okay, so now I run the ICA, I get the independent component scores, and here I'm creating a histogram of the first component and the second component.
cues.zh: 執行 ICA，得到獨立成分分數，畫第一與第二成分直方圖。

cues.en: And you can see that it's not exactly identical.
cues.zh: 並不完全一致。

cues.en: This one is kind of pushing up the distribution a little bit towards higher numbers, but they overall look pretty good.
cues.zh: 這個有點往較大數字推，但整體很好。

cues.en: I think we've gotten the distributions right.
cues.zh: 我覺得分布找對了。

cues.en: So this one looks pretty uniform.
cues.zh: 這個很均勻。

cues.en: This one looks pretty much like a power distribution.
cues.zh: 這個像冪次分布。

cues.en: So what we've done here is start with these two totally distinct distributions of data and then we linearly combine them.
cues.zh: 從兩個完全不同分布開始，線性結合。

cues.en: So we mixed them together, and then ICA was able to somewhat unmix them reasonably well.
cues.zh: 混在一起，ICA 再相當合理地分開。

cues.en: Okay, so now we're going to plot the data in the data space and also in the IC space.
cues.zh: 現在畫資料空間與 IC 空間。

cues.en: So here's what the data look like when they're mixed together.
cues.zh: 這是混合後資料。

cues.en: This is channel one and channel two, and that reflects this mixing here of these two signals.
cues.zh: 通道一與二，反映兩訊號混合。

cues.en: So you can see that it has this kind of, well, they're a little bit correlated in this sort of strange way.
cues.zh: 有一種奇怪方式的相關。

cues.en: And then what ICA did was, you know, rotate this and stretch open the axes a little bit to try to separate the variance related to each of these two features of the data.
cues.zh: ICA 旋轉、稍微打開座標軸，分開與兩特徵有關的變異。

cues.en: Okay, and then the final thing that we can look at is the original data versus the IC data.
cues.zh: 最後看原始資料相對 IC 資料。

cues.en: So that's actually a pretty interesting visualization.
cues.zh: 是有趣的視覺化。

cues.en: So this is the original signal one.
cues.zh: 這是原始訊號一。

cues.en: Now this is not the signal that got mixed together into the variable data.
cues.zh: 不是已混到 data 變數的訊號。

cues.en: This is the original source signal and here is the first independent component and this is the second source signal and the second independent component here.
cues.zh: 這是原始來源，這是第一獨立成分；這是第二來源與第二獨立成分。

cues.en: So you see that they are nearly perfectly correlated.
cues.zh: 幾乎完全相關。

cues.en: I mean, this is really brilliant.
cues.zh: 真的很棒。

cues.en: So, you know, we took these two different sources, two different signals, randomly mixed them together, and then ICA unmixed them really, really well.
cues.zh: 兩來源、兩訊號隨機混合，ICA 分離得很好。

cues.en: You can see there's a change in the scaling here, but that's not a big deal.
cues.zh: 尺度改變，但沒大問題。

cues.en: And here as well, it's slightly less, but that's still a really strong correlation here.
cues.zh: 這裡稍低，但仍很強相關。

cues.en: So overall, I think ICA did a really good job in this particular example dataset.
cues.zh: 整體在這份例子，ICA 做得很好。

cues.en: So now I'm here in Python.
cues.zh: 現在 Python。

cues.en: And so we're going to use the fast ICA algorithm that's been implemented in scikit-learn toolbox.
cues.zh: 使用 scikit-learn 的 FastICA。

cues.en: And this is basically what everyone recommends using for ICA in Python.
cues.zh: 基本上大家都推薦 Python ICA 用它。

cues.en: So I think that's a kind of reasonable approach.
cues.zh: 所以認為是合理方式。

cues.en: So I'm doing here what I, so this is basically just a translation of the MATLAB code.
cues.zh: 這裡基本上只是把 MATLAB 程式轉過來。

cues.en: So I create one non-Gaussian distribution, which is a uniform distribution, and here, a uniform distribution that's raised to the fourth power.
cues.zh: 一個均勻非高斯分布，另一個均勻分布取四次方。

cues.en: So that's really just gonna put a lot of data clustered close to zero and then we'll get kind of this almost power law-like distribution where the frequency of data values gets smaller
cues.zh: 很多點靠近 0，近似冪律，資料值愈大、

cues.en: as we get to larger numbers towards one.
cues.zh: 愈靠近 1，頻率愈小。

cues.en: Okay, and then what I'm going to show is the two individual distributions.
cues.zh: 展示兩個單獨分布。

cues.en: So here you see this is the first dataset with a uniform distribution, the second dataset with this kind of power law distribution, and then here is the signals combined,
cues.zh: 第一個均勻，第二個這種冪律分布，再把訊號

cues.en: just linearly summed, and then their distribution.
cues.zh: 線性相加，看分布。

cues.en: And you can see this is not exactly a Gaussian, but it certainly looks more like a Gaussian than either one of these distributions alone.
cues.zh: 不完全高斯，但肯定比兩個單獨更像。

cues.en: So this is the central limit theorem sort of developing.
cues.zh: 中央極限定理逐漸展現。

cues.en: This is the growing central limit theorem over here.
cues.zh: 這是發展中的中央極限定理。

cues.en: We would add more signals and more data from these signals.
cues.zh: 如果加入更多訊號、更多訊號資料，

cues.en: Then we would find that this gets even more like a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 就更像高斯。

cues.en: Okay, so then I run ICA and I'm running ICA on this dataset that I'm creating by mixing together these signals.
cues.zh: 對混合訊號產生的資料執行 ICA。

cues.en: So the first channel in this dataset is going to be 40% of dataset one and 30% of dataset two.
cues.zh: 第一通道為資料一 40% 加資料二 30%。

cues.en: And then the second channel in this variable is going to be 80% of dataset one and minus 70% of dataset two.
cues.zh: 第二通道為資料一 80% 減資料二 70%。

cues.en: So essentially what we're doing is linearly kind of, you know, pseudo randomly, except I just made up these numbers, but we are linearly kind of randomly combining
cues.zh: 基本上是線性、偽隨機，只是數字由我編，但可以說隨機地組合

cues.en: these two datasets into a different dataset, and then we're gonna run ICA on this mixed data.
cues.zh: 兩資料集成另一份，再對混合資料做 ICA。

cues.en: So then the goal is for ICA to see that we have mixed data and they look sort of Gaussian-ish, and then ICA
cues.zh: 目標是 ICA 看出混合、近似高斯，

cues.en: should be able to recover the original signals here.
cues.zh: 恢復原訊號。

cues.en: Okay, so let's see, so then I run ICA.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And so it looks like IC1 kind of matches our first data distribution in the sense that it was a uniform distribution,
cues.zh: IC1 有點符合第一個均勻分布，

cues.en: but this second IC doesn't really look anything like what we would expect based on how we simulated that second dataset.
cues.zh: 但第二 IC 完全不像依模擬方式預期的。

cues.en: So that one had a really sharp peak and then a very steep decay, whereas this shows actually almost like a shifted Gaussian.
cues.zh: 原本峰很尖、下降很快，這裡卻像平移的高斯。

cues.en: This is a Gaussian with some skew to it.
cues.zh: 有偏斜的高斯。

cues.en: Okay, so then it's not gonna be a big surprise that the data in the IC space are actually not doing a really great job of decoupling
cues.zh: 所以不意外，IC 空間資料，沒有很好分離

cues.en: the two variants sources in this data.
cues.zh: 兩個變異來源。

cues.en: So you see that there's still some correlation between IC1 and IC2.
cues.zh: IC1 與 IC2 仍有相關。

cues.en: So then we can plot this.
cues.zh: 可以畫圖。

cues.en: So now actually this one looks pretty good.
cues.zh: 這個其實不錯。

cues.en: So it looked like in this case the ICA did a good job of isolating the first data source.
cues.zh: 這次似乎很好分離第一來源。

cues.en: So this is the original signal.
cues.zh: 這是原訊號。

cues.en: This is the ground truth and this is IC1.
cues.zh: 真實答案，這是 IC1。

cues.en: Now in theory, you know, if ICA works perfectly, then what we should see is a, you know, just a perfectly straight line going up here and that would indicate that IC1
cues.zh: 理論上，若 ICA 完美，應是完全往上的直線，表示 IC1

cues.en: is perfectly reconstructing the original signal.
cues.zh: 完美重建來源。

cues.en: So this looks quite good.
cues.zh: 這看起來很好。

cues.en: I think this is a good job here, but you can see this is not doing a really great job.
cues.zh: 這裡做得好，但那裡不好。

cues.en: You know, we could forgive a negative correlation here because that would just be a sign flip and signs can be a little bit difficult to reconcile in these kinds of decompositions,
cues.zh: 負相關可以接受，只是符號翻轉，這類分解的符號有時難一致，

cues.en: but it's also quite wide, it's a little bit asymmetrically distributed, and I'm not very impressed with how FAST ICA performed even on this
cues.zh: 但它還很寬、分布有點不對稱，FastICA 的表現讓我不太滿意，即使資料

cues.en: very, very simple dataset where we start off with ground truth with variables where we know that they have a very strong non-Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 非常簡單，而且知道原始變數強烈非高斯。

cues.en: So, you know, what to do about this?
cues.zh: 怎麼辦？

cues.en: I thought for a little while about what I should do about this lecture and with this particular issue that the ICA implementation
cues.zh: 我想過這堂應如何處理，MATLAB 的 JADE

cues.en: of the JADE algorithm in MATLAB works really well.
cues.zh: 實作很好，

cues.en: And the ICA implementation of FAST ICA
cues.zh: Python 的 FastICA

cues.en: in Python doesn't work very well.
cues.zh: 卻不好。

cues.en: And in fact, I'm gonna run this again just to see how it comes out this time.
cues.zh: 其實再跑一次，看看這次如何。

cues.en: 'Cause sometimes this looks better, sometimes it looks even worse.
cues.zh: 有時較好，有時更差。

cues.en: So on the one hand, you know what, sometimes, so actually this one looks pretty decent.
cues.zh: 這次其實不錯。

cues.en: Sometimes what teachers do is, you know, they'll just pick the best examples to make it seem like it's all great.
cues.zh: 有時老師只挑最好例子，讓一切看起來很好。

cues.en: But I decided not to do that.
cues.zh: 但我決定不這樣做。

cues.en: You know, when you look around for ICA Python on the web, you'll find that basically everyone recommends using scikit-learn FAST ICA.
cues.zh: 上網找 Python ICA，幾乎人人推薦 scikit-learn FastICA。

cues.en: So I think this is a useful demonstration of how even established methods are not necessarily always going to produce really great results,
cues.zh: 所以這是有用示範，即使成熟方法，也不一定總有很好結果，

cues.en: even when you have pretty simple, straightforward datasets.
cues.zh: 即使資料簡單、直接。

cues.en: So it's always good to have a little bit of caution when approaching different analyses that you read online that sound really cool.
cues.zh: 面對網路上聽起來很酷的分析，保留一點謹慎總是好。

cues.en: So in this particular case, I don't think ICA did a good job on either of these.
cues.zh: 這次，兩者我都不覺得做得好。

cues.en: So I'm just flipping back to MATLAB really quickly to show you this is kind of an ideal result.
cues.zh: 快速切回 MATLAB，展示理想結果。

cues.en: This is really what we should see.
cues.zh: 這才是應有的。

cues.en: ICA should be able to recover the original sources.
cues.zh: ICA 應恢復原來源。

cues.en: And in Python, yeah, we've run it a couple times.
cues.zh: Python 跑過幾次。

cues.en: Sometimes it seems to look pretty decent and sometimes it doesn't really do such a good job.
cues.zh: 有時不錯，有時不好。

cues.en: But I would like to use this opportunity to reiterate something I mentioned in the very beginning of this course about simulating data.
cues.zh: 藉機重申課程最初談模擬資料的一點。

cues.en: And this shows one of the reasons why I think it's really important and really valuable to simulate data to test out your analyses because if you cannot trust a data analysis method
cues.zh: 這是為什麼模擬來測試分析很重要、有價值：如果方法在已知真相的模擬資料

cues.en: to work on simulated data where you know what the ground truth is, then I would be very cautious to apply this specific implementation
cues.zh: 都無法信任，我會非常謹慎，才把這個特定 ICA 實作，

cues.en: of independent components analysis to any real data where we have no idea what the ground truth is.
cues.zh: 用於完全不知道真相的真實資料。
